description: INSPIRE-HEP, the high-energy-physics literature database — search its HEPNames author records with a Lucene/Solr query such as a surname or ORCID. Returns each author's INSPIRE record id, preferred and alternative name forms, institutional affiliations, ORCID and arXiv categories. Answers which particle physicist a name refers to in INSPIRE and what their author record id is.
name: authors_search

outputSchema.description: Search results from INSPIRE-HEP authors API

title: Authors Search
